meta.name: pol-probe-advisor
meta.description: Select the right Proof of Life (PoL) probe based on hypothesis, risk, and resources. Use this to match the validation method to the real learning goal, not tooling comfort.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据假设和风险选择验证方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不确定时选择最合适的验证方法。
copy.tagline_en: Select validation methods based on hypothesis and risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to choose the right validation method under uncertainty.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你从 5 种验证方法中选出最适合当前假设、风险和资源的“生存证明”探针，确保用最便宜的方案验证最核心的风险。
howto.when: 当你提出一个需要验证的假设或想消除某个具体风险，但不确定该用哪种验证方法时触发。

say.text: 我想验证一个假设：HR 团队会信任 AI 写的职位描述。
say.note: Claude 会询问更多上下文并推荐探针类型。

say.text: 帮我选一个验证方法，我有 2 周时间，没有工程支持。
say.note: Claude 会根据资源推荐合适的探针。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to select the right Proof of Life (PoL) probe from 5 types based on your hypothesis, risk, and resources, ensuring you match the cheapest prototype to the harshest truth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a hypothesis to validate or a specific risk to eliminate, but are unsure which validation method to use.

say_en.text: I want to validate a hypothesis: HR teams will trust AI-drafted job descriptions.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for more context and recommend a probe type.

say_en.text: Help me pick a validation method; I have 2 weeks and no engineering support.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend a probe based on resources.
